about.title: About the restaurant
about.storyTitle: From an idea to a place worth staying in
about.storyText1: Lumière opened in 2016 as a small project by a team of chefs in love with European cuisine. Today it's a restaurant people return to for birthdays, business meetings, and ordinary Friday evenings.
about.storyText2: We work with farms around Moscow and shift the menu with the seasons — so the table always carries what genuinely tastes best right now.
